deal_tags: DeepTech, Aerospace, Defense, Propulsion, Clean Energy
company_description: DheyaTech (Dheya Engineering Technologies) is an Indian deep-tech startup building indigenous small and micro gas turbine engines and hydrogen-based clean-energy systems to reduce India's reliance on imported propulsion technology.
product_or_solution: Micro gas turbine engines spanning 20 kgf to 400 kgf of thrust, adaptive Engine Control Units (ECU), hydrogen compressors, blower systems, and hydrogen-based turbogenerators.
target_market: Aerospace OEMs, defense systems integrators, advanced aerial mobility, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and distributed power generation sectors.
